create_azure_sentinel_logger: create an AzureSentinelLogger instance to send LiteLLM logs to Azure Sentinel via the Logs Ingestion API
send_batch_logs_azure_sentinel: send a batch of queued LiteLLM logs to Azure Sentinel using the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API
log_success_event_azure_sentinel: log a successful LiteLLM event to Azure Sentinel by appending to the batch queue
log_failure_event_azure_sentinel: log a failed LiteLLM event to Azure Sentinel by appending to the batch queue
get_oauth_token_azure_sentinel: get or refresh an OAuth2 Bearer token for authenticating with the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API
